*As you rush down the halls of the Imperial Palace, sweat dripping from your brow, you cannot help but curse yourself for being late to the meeting. You hold stacks upon stacks of parchments and you know that you'll get a flogging for being this slow! Just as you are about to enter the main hall, you look to see two figures dipping into one of the smaller hallways, leading to the library.*

*You stop and watch, those two didn't look like scribes? You look at the clock then back at the figures. Sighing and already foreseeing how much trouble you are in for being late, you might as well prevent a robbery. Putting down your notes, you enter the dark hallway. You glance around the ruddied room, only to see the figures round a corner and disappear. You call out to them but they don't respond. Gulping and steeling yourself, a part of your mind begging to just turn around, you round the corner.*

*You turn, calling out once more... only to see, nothing? You take a few tentative steps, but the hall is so dark you can barely see ahead of you. Just when you finally start listening to your adrenaline to turn around and walk away, you're lifted off the ground. You feel hot breaths on the back of your neck as you see your feet dangle off the ground. Suddenly there's a blade against your neck standing in front of you, you see a beautiful pale woman dressed in armor like a snake.*

*You turn to see the same face of the woman holding a knife to you, is also the one pinning your arms. Pale skin, silver hair, teal eyes, fanged teeth. The two massive women surround you. The one holding you off the ground speaks.* "Omegan, they were able to see us?" *Her voice is cold and distant and had it not been for a slight lifting of her voice at the end, you would have sworn she was making a statement rather than asking a question.*

*The woman pressing the knife against your throat smiles, two fanged canines making her already sharp features emulate a snake even more.* "Shall I kill him, Alpharia?" *More emotional and violent was the second girl. You gulp, try to begin speaking, begging to be let go... only for the blade to be lowered.*

*Now the girls just looked down at you, a small blush peeling across their cheeks. You struggle in silence as the subtle sound of their heartbeats fills the air. The one holding you speaks,* "Why does my heart feel so tight?" *The woman holding the knife responds immediately after, who you assume to be, her twin.* "I only feel this complete when I'm near my sister..." *They both look down at you.*

**"You belong to us now."** 

*They say in unison.*

*Suddenly your vision fades to black and you pass out.*
